releases.name: VENERA 31
releases.summary:
The orbital eyes are gone. In a year the program goes blind for good - and what isn't verified by then never happened.

Three rovers are still alive on Venus. One downlink. It is narrow.

You are the Operator. Something is growing down there, and the Company pays for verified truth only.

A short, replayable descent into corporate cosmic horror. No jump-scare filler - just you, a bad monitor, and the growing certainty that the defects are looking back.

releases.name: Khudran: Saudi National Day
releases.summary: Celebrate Saudi National Day the Khudran way! Give lollipops, spray celebration snow, and play chaotic mini-games in this fast-paced Saudi comedy game

releases.name: sussy babies: reborn
releases.summary: Sussy Babies: Reborn is a psychological horror experience, where you and your friend get trapped in a mysterious mine system, the deeper you go, the stranger the mines become, and the more challenging it gets to find your way out.

releases.name: Shoot Together
releases.summary: Run non-stop and blast everything in your way! SINGLE-PLAYER: Level up, fight bosses, and unlock permanent upgrades. PVP MODE: Make split-second roguelike choices mid-run to leave your friend behind and claim the top spot on the leaderboards!

releases.name: Chaos Warrior
releases.summary: Chaos Warrior is a retro JRPG inspired by the NES era. Fight deadly monsters, explore dangerous locations, and gain the strength to become the hero that saves the world!

releases.name: Tintle's Great Colorful Adventure
releases.summary: Help Tintle, an adventurer who gains the ability to change colors as they travel through the sky to find their way back home. Jump, change between colors, teleport, and manipulate gravity to advance further through the clouds dodging traps as you get that much closer to finally arriving back home.

releases.name: The Last Cornfield
releases.summary: Protect humanity’s final cornfield in a melancholy strategy game where scarecrows defend the crop against increasingly desperate crows across 67 levels.

releases.name: Zingers
releases.summary: The comedy party game where the room writes the jokes. 3-16 players, one screen, and any phone for a controller — no extra copies, no downloads. Answer unhinged prompts, then flip it and write the setups. Funniest line wins. Bring friends and a group chat's worth of bad decisions.

releases.name: Cataclysmic
releases.summary: A explosive and dynamic top down shooter where you collect time energy from strongholds that represent cultures and mythologies from history in an effort to restore order.

releases.name: Click to Farm
releases.summary: Click across three different sections of your farm to gather plants, catch fish, and befriend animals. A cozy idle/clicker game that sits anywhere on your screen and offers a chill grind. Collect, upgrade, and relax.

releases.name: CompaDesk
releases.summary: A cozy desktop companion that lives in the corner of your screen. Feed it, earn its trust, and help it evolve into a powerful guardian whenever enemies attack.

releases.name: GORE TANK
releases.summary: GORETANK is a twin-stick shooter inspired by classic arcade and console games of the 1980s. Take control of a hover tank and fight to survive against endless hordes of demons.

releases.name: Space Trader Corps
releases.summary: A real-time multiplayer space trading game in a shared persistent galaxy. Haul cargo across a living player-driven galaxy, mine asteroids, colonize and industrialize planets, become a pirate (or a hunt them), or out-trade every other captain - solo or with your friends. PvP & PvE.

releases.name: Woolmates
releases.summary: Two balls of wool, one thread, one big adventure! Jump, swing and puzzle your way together through more than 50 interwoven levels — in co-op or multiplayer.

releases.name: Lunokhod
releases.summary: A simple retro sci-fi base builder with a socialist twist. Mine resources, build structures, prepare for crisis. Launch the Buran rocket, and usher in a new era of socialist production.
